response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.avg_qty) AS avg_quantity, AVG(cat.avg_diff) AS avg_difference, AVG(cat.avg_diff - m.mean_diff) AS avg_excess FROM cat CROSS JOIN m WHERE cat.avg_diff > m.mean_diff
